material_defect.high_tier_risk: Weakens family-disjoint cross-model external validity and creates overlap with earlier PlanCarry development/confirmation identities.
material_defect.name: HISTORICAL_FAMILY_EXPOSURE_NOT_EXCLUDED
material_defect.statement: Exact game paths are fresh, but the selection rule does not exclude previously persisted exact family identities. 27/40 selected families have prior design/science metadata hits under other trials, so historically-unexposed is defensible only at episode/path level, not family level.

other_semantics: PASS. Interface adaptation is model-native only; substantive V2.1 planner/action/control semantics remain fixed. Normalized-depth layer mapping, alpha, t2/reset site, LPA, controls, sign/Holm/effect guards, true reset/one intervention/no reinjection and strict primary activation gates are prospectively frozen.

repair_feasibility.preferred_prospective_repair: Before any Phi model/environment outcome, use a fresh salt and rebuild from exact-family-unexposed metadata. Preferred strongest repair: 20 train families for development plus a different 20 train families for confirmation, with exact family/path disjointness and no replacement. Preserve model, causal mechanism, layer map, alpha grid, controls, tests, effect guards and activation gates. Alternatively explicitly weaken the claim and justify a smaller development cohort, but do not silently relabel path-unexposed as family-unexposed.
